LOG.description: Directory where log files are stored

DEVICE.description: Serial port device to use for AVR communication (e.g. /dev/ttyS1)

SHUTDOWN.description: Default shutdown time in 24-hour HH:MM format

POWERON.description: Default power-on time in 24-hour HH:MM format

DISKCHECK.description: Disk usage percentage threshold to illuminate disk LED (0-100), or OFF

ROOT.description: Root partition for disk usage check

WORK.description: Working partition for disk usage check
